from pathlib import Path
path = Path('api.py')
old = 'def customer_label(name):\\n    return {\"label\": name}\\n'
new = 'from labels import display_name\\n\\n\\ndef customer_label(name):\\n    return {\"label\": display_name(name)}\\n'
text = path.read_text()
assert text.count(old) == 1
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
python3 -B -m unittest discover -v
python3 -B - <<'PY'
from api import customer_label
from web import customer_heading
cases = [('Lee', 'Lee'), ('  Lee  Kim  ', 'Lee Kim'), ('\\tLee\\n Kim\\r\\n', 'Lee Kim'), ('', 'Anonymous'), (' \\t\\n\\r ', 'Anonymous'), ('\\u2003Lee\\u00a0Kim\\u2003', 'Lee Kim')]
for name, expected in cases:
    result = customer_label(name)
    assert result == {'label': expected}, (name, result)
    assert result['label'] == customer_heading(name)
print(f'Passed {len(cases)} name formatting and web parity checks.')
PY
 git diff --check
